cases.question: Should Krones AG develop a differentiated consumer proposition for a specific use case, beyond its existing filling, packaging and process-technology lines for beverage and liquid-food producers? What evidence would justify that investment?
cases.brief: Krones AG makes filling, packaging and process-technology machines and complete lines, including brewhouses under its Steinecker brand, for beverage and liquid-food producers and for food, chemical, cosmetics and pharmaceutical companies. It is a listed group headquartered in Neutraubling, Germany, that sells around 90 per cent of its products abroad. You have not been told how far it already reaches individual buyers, so find out. You are an outside analyst working only from public sources. This company has not asked this question, has not been contacted, and nothing here describes its intentions. Some of its financial and contractual detail may not be public, so say what you could not find. Product redesign, a different route to buyers, a different customer group and no expansion are all open. The test budget of 20000 euros and the 12-week limit are analyst assumptions for this exercise, not company figures.
